title: Canonical exchange under an isomorphism over the projective-line base
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, S and X schemes, f:X→S proper, and i:X≅ProjectiveLine(S) with i.hom followed by q equal to f, where q is the projective-line projection. Write p₁,p₂ for the projections of ProjectiveLine(S)×ₛProjectiveLine(S), r₁,r₂ for those of X×ₛX, and j=i×ₛi. Use the derived module-sheaf pullbacks, ordinary direct images, and compact-support direct images of def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data. Let β:j* followed by Rr₂! ≅ Rp₂* followed by i* be secondProjectionComparison, obtained from projectionComparison by reducing the true projection. Let δ be properExchange for the self-product square of q; let σ:i* followed by r₁* ≅ p₁* followed by j* be the pullback comparison of firstProjectionSquare; let e:Rf! followed by f* ≅ r₁* followed by Rr₂! be TraceDiagonalDatum.baseChangeIso; and let c:f*≅q* followed by i* be leftDerivedUpperStarComp for i;q=f. For every derived complex B on ProjectiveLine(S), define g_B:Rf!(i*B)→Rq*(B) as proper forget-supports at i*B, then the inverse direct-image composition comparison for i;q=f, then Rq* applied to pushPull at B. Here pushPull is the constructed isomorphism Ri* i*≅Id, not an arbitrary equivalence counit. Then β at p₁*B, followed by i* applied to δ inverse at B, equals Rr₂! applied to σ inverse at B, followed by e inverse at i*B, f* applied to g_B, and c at Rq*B. All compositions are in the written order. This identity holds for arbitrary B and involves no Tate exponent, twist transport, trace arrow, splitting, or diagonal class.

proof.text: Prove compatibility of compact-support exchange with proper forget-supports for an arbitrary Cartesian square of proper vertical maps. Use the chosen compactification, its pulled-back compactification, the proved refinement/forget-supports equation, and the proved compactification base-change/forget-supports equation. Typed private intermediate equations keep the chosen compactification and derived category interfaces fixed. This is the general private argument already used in ProperSelfExchangeForgetSupports.

For morphisms a:X→Y, b:Y→Z and c:X→Z with a;b=c, consider the commutative square with top a, left c, right b and bottom id_Z. In that square, the inverse-image square comparison is c* of the identity pullback comparison followed by the pullback compositor for a;b. This follows from leftDerivedUpperStarComp_id_right_hom_app. Transpose the ordinary exchange map along c* adjoint Rc*. The conjugate direct-image compositor and naturality of the pullback compositor reduce the equality to the counit naturality for b and the left triangle for a. Thus ordinary exchange is the identity pullback comparison, then Rb* of the unit for a, then direct-image composition.

Specialize the preceding identity to a=i.hom and b=q. Postcompose it by presentationTrace. Cancel the direct-image compositor with its inverse and apply the existing proved unit_comp_pushPull. The result is exactly the identity pullback comparison at Rq*B.

Apply derivedBaseChangeMap_cube to the projective-line self-product square, the two projection squares induced by productMap, the self-product square of f, and the two copies of the square i;q=f over the identity. Precompose with the invertible projective and projection exchanges. Substitute the preceding presentationTrace identity and the identity-square comparison, then cancel the ordinary f exchange. This proves the ordinary presentation exchange equation, with no compact-support functors remaining.

Expand secondProjectionComparison at the first-coordinate pullback of B. First transport the whole proper comparison along the equality projection(f,true)=snd using a heterogeneous equality, then take components. The fixed true-projection equality contributes the identity; the remaining factors are proper forget-supports and inverse projection exchange. Substitute the ordinary presentation equation. Naturality moves the proper comparison across the inverse first-projection pullback square comparison. The inverse of the proved compact-support/ordinary exchange compatibility replaces the remaining two factors by inverse compact-support exchange followed by f* of proper forget-supports. Combine the two f* maps by functoriality. These are exactly the original displayed factors, without changing any hypothesis or public signature. For the compact-support compatibility expose baseChangeIso.hom and properExchange.hom at the natural-transformation level first, then evaluate the raw proper-compatibility equation. Specialize a proved generic categorical family only after fixing all functors, natural isomorphisms, and their compatibility equations. This keeps the proof independent of expensive component-level definitional reductions.

lean.statement:
theorem presentationExchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (B : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) :
    (secondProjectionComparison A f i hi).hom.app
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (projectiveLineDiagonalProjection S false)).obj B) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
        ((properExchange A (projectiveProjectionSquare S true)).inv.app B) =
    (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (pullback.snd f f)).map
        ((derivedSquareUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (firstProjectionSquare f i hi).toCommSq).inv.app B) ≫
      (TraceDiagonalDatum.baseChangeIso (Λ := A) f).inv.app
        ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj B) ≫
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj B) ≫
          presentationTrace A f i hi B) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i.hom
        (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) f hi.symm).hom.app
          ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj B)
